rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Vision × Detail split — vision layer needs no KB backing, detail layer must.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 111: "Carve-out invoked is §7 (named framing piece), NOT §2a (durable account)". Rule 7 as written governs whether a claim needs a citation at all (Antti's own framing = no backing owed; practitioner claims/numbers = backing owed) — confirmed by `curriculum/backing-format.md` line 42, the only other place §7 is invoked: "vision layer is the maintainer's framing and needs no KB backing... it marks the line as deliberately unsourced, not as debt." The Willison citation is the opposite case — a Detail-layer, already-sourced external claim (dated, attributed, URL-backed) — so §7 doesn't speak to whether ITS 6-month freshness clock can be waived. §7 answers "does this need a source," not "is this already-sourced claim's age acceptable." The relabel correctly rules out 2a but supplies a rule number that doesn't license what it's being cited to license.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Drop the §7 citation; state the exception in the same plain terms `getting-going.md` uses for its own precedent ("outside the window by maintainer decision, precedent: the Cherny video exception" — no rule number attached there) rather than implying a compendium rule grants a freshness waiver that rule 7's text doesn't actually contain. The underlying editorial call and its fallback are sound — only the rule citation is miscited. Not a new finding in substance (same underlying gap the prior run caught), but the fix applied papered over 2a with a second wrong citation rather than removing the false compendium anchor.
